title: payment.created v1
description: Published on subject payment.created when a payment enters status created: the provider's notification is recorded, nothing is booked yet. Nats-Msg-Id is <payment_id>.created (one per payment), so the stream drops repeated announcements within its duplicate window. Carries our IDs (TypeIDs) only, never provider identifiers. Consumers ignore unknown fields. Hand-written; shared by the Node and Go implementations.

event_id.description: Identifies this business event. A payment can be announced more than once (a re-announcement after a failed publish gets a new event_id); consumers are idempotent on the payment's state.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units (cents) as a string of digits, greater than zero.

occurred_at.description: When the payment entered status created.
